'''Dariana's Keepers''' were a group associated with the [[Tarasin]] [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Dariana]], a leader of the [[Hiironi irstat]] on the<ref name="Home of Wisdom">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040325wisdom|text=Home of Wisdom|int=Home of Wisdom (article)}}</ref> planet<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Dariana's Keepers accompanied Dariana to the [[Home of Wisdom (Cularin)|Home of Wisdom]], a revered Tarasin meeting place on Cularin, where Dariana had called a meeting of Tarasin [[irstat]] leaders to discuss a [[se'neth]] vision. During the meeting, Dariana paused for a moment, causing the Keepers to worry that she had fallen [[Sleep/Legends|asleep]].<ref name="Home of Wisdom" />
